intro: In Stormwind's Park, Nara Meideros guides young seekers in Elune's teachings. As a night elf priestess in the human capital, she offers a familiar spiritual presence to her kin.

p: Nara Meideros serves Elune far from Kalimdor, across the Great Sea in Stormwind City. In the Park, night elf druids and priests have tended a green refuge. Nara guides young seekers in devotion to the Moon Goddess. Human priests serve the Holy Light in nearby Cathedral Square, while Nara gives night elves visiting or living in the Eastern Kingdoms a connection to their own faith.
